title: Caves, Sections & Links
selected_by_owner: Owner continued the approved MMHT fifteen-cycle map program.

in_scope: Edit three stacked cave floors with irregular chambers, linear passages, shaft and ladder anchors, named stable feature IDs and authored elevation levels.
Inspect a vertical section, create and follow explicit directional same-map and cross-map links, and distinguish visual crossings from topology.
Attach a topology role to an existing cave feature without reassigning its feature ID; export full GM draft and filtered player references.
boundaries: Standalone map-only authoring. No mining yield, travel authorization, ecological simulation, creature production, installed product integration or permission grant.
Earlier MMHT-01 through MMHT-09 tools remain available. Physical Android acceptance is still pending.

evidence.validation: Executed packaged HTML in Chromium via Playwright set_content (direct file/http navigation restricted by harness). Both editable examples passed native documentError validation. Verified hoist forward path and reverse rejection, nonconnected crossing, three-elevation section, GM-only feature filtering (12 GM vs 10 player nodes), editor drawing a new shaft on canvas, renaming and owner reference persistence, GM visibility changes, cross-map navigation, editable draft browser export and reimport (12 feature rows, 8 connections), and no page errors. Browser storage unavailable under about:blank; file round-trip used. Physical device and installed-application integration untested.

next_action: Owner reviews MMHT-10 cave samples; continue to MMHT-11 Mine & Deposit Maps on direction.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-10 HTML, editable Brinegate sample, role-filtered references, browser edit and round-trip checks.

stop_reason.evidence: Editable cave topology, section view, explicit route semantics, hidden-content filtering, and standalone file round-trip validated.
